name: Common Reading Pipeline
description: A generic reading pipeline: recognizes requests to read stories, articles, reports, horoscopes and more aloud, and routes them to whichever installed provider skill can supply that content. Not tied to any single content type or source.
examples: Tell me a story about cinderella
Read me an article about penguins
Tell me a story from grimm
Read me a horoscope about leo
author: andlo

setup_notes.heading: Install
setup_notes.content:
pip install ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin

Add it to your pipeline in `mycroft.conf` **right after your stop
matcher** (`stop_high`/`ovos-stop-pipeline-plugin-high`) - roughly
where OCP sits, not before stop. "Stop" should always be the most
reliable, highest-priority command regardless of what skill is active;
putting anything ahead of it undermines that guarantee for every skill,
not just this one. An earlier version of this README recommended
putting this plugin first - that was wrong, and has been reverted; see
the note at the end of this section for why.

**Don't copy-paste a whole pipeline block from here or anywhere else** -
your existing list already has entries specific to your install (the
exact names/order vary: `stop_high` vs `ovos-stop-pipeline-plugin-high`,
whether pers…

da-dk.name: Generisk læsepipeline
da-dk.description: En generisk læsepipeline: genkender anmodninger om at få historier, artikler, rapporter, horoskoper og mere læst højt, og videresender dem til det installerede skill, der kan levere indholdet. Ikke bundet til én bestemt indholdstype eller kilde.
examples: Fortæl mig en historie om askepot
Læs mig en artikel om pingviner
Fortæl mig en historie fra grimm

de-de.name: Allgemeine Vorlese-Pipeline
de-de.description: Eine allgemeine Vorlese-Pipeline: erkennt Anfragen, Geschichten, Artikel und mehr vorzulesen, und leitet sie an das passende installierte Skill weiter.
examples: Erzähl mir eine Geschichte über Aschenputtel
Erzähl mir eine Geschichte von grimm

es-es.name: Pipeline de lectura genérica
es-es.description: Una pipeline de lectura genérica: reconoce solicitudes para leer cuentos, artículos y más en voz alta, y las dirige a la skill instalada que pueda ofrecer ese contenido.

fr-fr.name: Pipeline de lecture générique
fr-fr.description: Une pipeline de lecture générique : reconnaît les demandes de lecture d'histoires, d'articles et plus encore, et les redirige vers le skill installé qui peut fournir ce contenu.

it-it.name: Pipeline di lettura generica
it-it.description: Una pipeline di lettura generica: riconosce le richieste di leggere storie, articoli e altro ad alta voce, e le indirizza allo skill installato che può fornire quel contenuto.

nl-nl.name: Generieke voorleespipeline
nl-nl.description: Een generieke voorleespipeline: herkent verzoeken om verhalen, artikelen en meer voor te lezen, en stuurt ze door naar de geïnstalleerde skill die die inhoud kan leveren.
examples: Vertel me een verhaal over assepoester
Vertel me een verhaal van grimm

pt-pt.name: Pipeline de leitura genérica
pt-pt.description: Uma pipeline de leitura genérica: reconhece pedidos para ler histórias, artigos e mais em voz alta, e encaminha-os para a skill instalada que possa fornecer esse conteúdo.
